title: Meaningful listening
summary: How music formats like streaming, vinyl and tape shape the way people pay attention to what they hear.
intro: My bachelor's thesis, an exploratory design research study into how the format we listen on (streaming, vinyl, tape or CD) affects whether listening feels meaningful.

card.quote: How might we create a more meaningful experience around listening to recorded music?

facts.Methods: Literature review, semi-structured interviews, observation, thematic analysis
facts.Participants: 7 listeners who switch between streaming and physical formats
